## User flow and acceptance criteria

Link the controlling issue and describe the user journey. Mark each relevant acceptance criterion as implemented, verified in its target environment, pending, or explicitly deferred.

## Visual and state evidence (UI changes)

Attach sanitized before/after screenshots or recordings using synthetic data. Cover relevant default, loading/pending, empty, success, error, offline, permission-denied, disabled, completed, light/dark and migration/recovery states. If screenshots are omitted, state the reason and obtain reviewer approval.

Record 320 px, representative phone/tablet widths, landscape and 200% zoom where applicable. Record keyboard/focus, contrast/reflow and reduced-motion results; distinguish automated checks from required manual assistive-technology checks. Link the user flow and record design/product approval where visual judgment is required. Native UI claims require native/device evidence.
